**Default skipped directories** — `zgrep` (a.k.a. `zigrep`, `README.md:7`) skips these directory names by default:

`.git`, `.zig-cache`, `__pycache__`, `node_modules`, `.venv`, `venv`, `target`, `.cache`, `.idea`, `.vscode` — `src/filter.zig:17-28` (documented in `GUIA.md:335`).

**How it applies:** `FilterEngine.isDirExcluded` compares each directory name against `default_excluded_dirs` when `use_defaults` is set (`src/filter.zig:512-521`); that flag defaults to `true` (`src/filter.zig:328`) and is cleared only by `--no-ignore` / `--no-default-ignore` (`src/main.zig:2424`, `src/main.zig:2546`; flags documented at `src/main.zig:208-210`). The walker prunes such directories during enumeration (`src/kamikaze.zig:340`, `src/kamikaze.zig:671`).

**Are `dist` or `build` among them? No.** Neither name appears in the default list (`src/filter.zig:17-28`), so both are searched by default unless excluded explicitly via `--exclude-dir`, `.gitignore`/`.dataignore`, or `--no-default-ignore`.

(Note: default *file-extension* exclusions are a separate list, `src/filter.zig:30-47`.)
